stage0055_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That wipes out the defense force.」

stage0055_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Don't let your guard down.
　They're only the opening act.」

stage0055_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$メラン$$
「The Fifth Luna garrison is wiped out.」

stage0055_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$n
「Doesn't look like the $$レウルーラ$$'s here.」

stage0055_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$シン$$
「But there's another Red Comet here...!」

stage0055_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...」

stage0055_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I've been waiting, $c.
　But this is a fact that must not change.」

stage0055_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「All units, scatter!
　Switch to defense!」

stage0055_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Now it's our turn to take on $c!」

stage0055_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$クェス$$
「If you want a fight, I won't back down...!」

stage0055_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$...!
　You're here too...!」

stage0055_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カツ$$
「Calm down, Hasa!
　In the chaos, we might get a shot at $$クェス$$!」

stage0055_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（$$バナージ$$...
　Is this our fate, then...）

stage0055_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Ms. $$マリーダ$$...
　So you really are going to fight...）

stage0055_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　We don't know what the enemy's after,
　but we're retaking Fifth Luna!」

stage0055_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll smash through them and draw him out!」

stage0055_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「A unit is closing in on this sector!
　It's Neo Zeon's!」

stage0055_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$オットー$$
「One more reinforcement won't change a thing now!」

stage0055_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$レイアム$$
「What...! Acceleration is triple a normal unit's!」

stage0055_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no mistaking it!
　That's...!」

stage0055_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm going to hear it, $$シャア$$!
　Your true intentions!」

stage0055_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You must know this world's in crisis too!
　Keep this up and humanity really ends!」

stage0055_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's why people must change...!
　Beyond this war!」

stage0055_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You're rushing it, $$シャア$$!
　People and the world both need time to change!」

stage0055_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シャア$$
「You too must know there's no time left, $$アムロ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$シャア$$
「Unless humanity moves into a new world,
　into space, our souls are bound to gravity forever!」

stage0055_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'm prepared to bear everything for that!」

stage0055_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't tell me... you mean to use this Fifth Luna...!」

stage0055_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$シャア$$
「Just as you think.
　I'm going to drop this on Earth...!」

stage0055_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$n
「Do you have any idea how much damage that'll cause!」

stage0055_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Wasn't this war supposed to leave the
　colonies unharmed!?」

stage0055_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Answer me, $$シャア$$!
　Is this what you call a fight!」

stage0055_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$アムロ$$...!
　No, $c!
　Come to Neo Zeon with me!」

stage0055_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'll need your strength to lead humanity forward!
　And together, we'll overthrow the old order!」

stage0055_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you talking about the Earth supremacists!?」

stage0055_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right!
　They haven't changed a bit since the days
　of the $$ティターンズ$$ and $$ブルーコスモス$$!」

stage0055_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$シン$$
「Even so, starting a war means
　dragging innocent people into it too!」

stage0055_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This isn't like the $$エゥーゴ$$!
　This only spreads sorrow across the whole world!」

stage0055_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$!
　Is this what you learned fighting $$トレーズ$$ and Zero!?」

stage0055_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Whatever $$トレーズ$$ entrusted to you,
　it can't have been this!」

stage0055_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$シャア$$
「...The one to carry on his wish isn't me...」

stage0055_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't run, $$シャア$$!
　If you care for the world's future, come with us!」

stage0055_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Got you now, $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You avoided a fatal blow...!
　I'll grant you that much!」

stage0055_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「His existence confuses the Supreme Commander!
　Leave this to me!」

stage0055_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$!
　Your existence cannot be allowed!」

stage0055_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Even that Gundam is coming here...
　what's going on!?」

stage0055_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Hurry, $$アムロ$$!
　It's your Gundam!」

stage0055_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you've boarded the $$νガンダム$$...!」

stage0055_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's fine.
　$$アムロ$$ will need that Gundam.」

stage0055_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シャア$$
「If something should happen to me,
　I'll need you to take action.」

stage0055_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Understood.
　I'll pray for your safety.」

stage0055_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$アムロ$$!
　If you deny me, then stop me!」

stage0055_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You don't have to tell me!」

stage0055_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$アムロ$$'s consciousness is flowing into me...」

stage0055_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Anger... sorrow... hesitation...
　And resolve...!」

stage0055_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$メラン$$
「Captain!
　A transmission from Federation Supreme Command!
　The fleet will reach us in three minutes!」

stage0055_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ブライト$$
「You heard it!
　All units, hold the line for these 3 minutes!」

stage0055_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$!
　If that's what you want, we'll stop you!」

stage0055_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シャア$$
「Come, then!
　For humanity, I'll surpass you and the past!」

stage0055_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$シャア$$
「So there's still hesitation left in me...!」

stage0055_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$アムロ$$...!
　No matter what you say to me,
　I'll follow my own will!」

stage0055_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$メラン$$
「The Federation fleet will arrive soon!」

stage0055_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Good!
　We'll join them and go on the offensive at once!」

stage0055_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「An enemy ship is heading for us!」

stage0055_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$ガランシェール$$, fall back!
　Hurry!」

stage0055_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy ship is pulling away!」

stage0055_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$オットー$$
「What was that all about...」

stage0055_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シャア$$
（So $$ハマーン$$ got what she wanted too...）

stage0055_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$シャア$$
「All units, fall back.
　We're abandoning Fifth Luna.」

stage0055_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$カツ$$
「No, Hasa!
　Chasing them is pointless!」

stage0055_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$桂$$
「What's this...?
　After all that talk of resolve,
　the retreat sure was quick.」

stage0055_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What do you make of it, Captain?」

stage0055_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$'s resolve was genuine...
　But there seemed to be hesitation in this plan.」

stage0055_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$... what are you in such a hurry for...?）

stage0055_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「After it's all over, huh...」

stage0055_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$エマ$$
「Brig. Gen. $$サイガス・エイロニー$$...
　He also heads EFF Supreme Command's
　campaign against Neo Zeon」

stage0055_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$リディ$$
「So he's effectively the Federation's
　top man in this war?」

stage0055_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$エマ$$
「Yes...
　And he's also known as a hawkish Earth
　supremacist」

stage0055_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A man like that, commanding the operation...」

stage0055_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$サイガス$$
「There's also a battle report.
　$c, your ships will join us and fall
　under my command from here on」

stage0055_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Even more overbearing than I'd heard」

stage0055_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ブライト$$
「My apologies, General.
　As an independent unit, we hold the right
　to decide our own actions」

stage0055_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ブライト$$
「From here, we pursue the Neo Zeon
　Supreme Commander」

stage0055_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Dawdle, and we lose our chance.
　...All hands, pull out of this area!
　We're pursuing Neo Zeon!」

stage0055_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Supreme Command's been interfering with
　Londo Bell for a while now.
　He must've finally had enough」

stage0055_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Then we'll exercise our rights as an
　independent unit and take on a new mission!」

stage0055_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Damn you, $$ブライト・ノア$$...!」

stage0055_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Damn $c...!
　Keep getting in my way, and remember
　that I have my own methods too...!」

stage0055_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tch! Even with the Colonel watching,
　is this as far as I get!」

stage0055_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll pay this back, I swear...!
　$$ギュネイ・ガス$$, falling back!」

stage0055_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Pathetic, $$ギュネイ$$.
　Go get your enhancements redone」

stage0055_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$クェス$$
「How dare you, to $$ギュネイ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$クェス$$
「Shut up!
　The Colonel's watching!
　I won't lose!」

stage0055_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「This is humiliating!
　Right in front of the Colonel, how dare you!」

stage0055_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Fall back, $$アンジェロ$$.
　There's still work I need you to do」

stage0055_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...My apologies, Colonel.
　$$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$ will fall back」

stage0055_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Humiliating! To fail the operation
　the Colonel devised...!」

stage0055_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Remember this, $c!
　I will wipe out this disgrace, I swear it!」

stage0055_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Unsightly, $$アンジェロ$$. In the end, you're
　just $$フロンタル$$'s private soldiers」

stage0055_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「This is as far as I go...!
　$$マリーダ・クルス$$, falling back!」

stage0055_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（That four-winged pilot...
　shares a bond of hearts with $$バナージ$$...）

stage0055_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Even if we could understand each other,
　is fighting still unavoidable...）

stage0055_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$クェス$$
「No good!
　The unit won't hold much longer!」

stage0055_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Not even $$ハサウェイ$$'s voice reaches her...）

stage0055_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「How dare you, to $$クェス$$!」

stage0055_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll pay back what you did to $$クェス$$!
　Here I come, $c!」

stage0055_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$! Listen to me!」

stage0055_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$クェス$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$! You're fighting with $c!?」

stage0055_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「It's to bring you back!!
　Get out of that mobile suit, $$クェス$$!」

stage0055_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$クェス$$
「Bring me back, what's that supposed to mean!?
　I'm not yours!」

stage0055_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm my own person!
　Only the Colonel really understands that!」

stage0055_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$クェス$$
「Shut up!
　Keep following me, and I'll deal with you,
　even if it's you, $$ハサウェイ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$! Listen to me!」

stage0055_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$クェス$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$! You're fighting with $c!?」

stage0055_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「It's to bring you back!
　Get out of that mobile suit, $$クェス$$!」

stage0055_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$クェス$$
「Bring me back, what's that supposed to mean!?
　I'm not yours!」

stage0055_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm my own person!
　Only the Colonel really understands that!」

stage0055_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$クェス$$
「The Colonel's watching!
　I have to live up to his expectations!」

stage0055_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$クェス$$
「Shut up!
　Keep following me, and I'll deal with you,
　even if it's you, $$ハサウェイ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アムロ$$!
　Your existence has no place in this world!」

stage0055_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アムロ$$
（What is this feeling...!?
　It's like I'm caught in the illusion
　of fighting $$シャア$$ again...!）

stage0055_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$バナージ$$, is it...!
　Even you will have to withdraw here...!」

stage0055_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$バナージ$$
（This man isn't just a soldier...!
　It's like the whole world is being
　dragged into him...!）

stage0055_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I have to stop him...!
　He's someone who crushes possibility itself!）

stage0055_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$!
　You've gotten a bit better at this!」

stage0055_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll move forward, even lost in doubt!
　If you're going to get in my way...!」

stage0055_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's the man the Colonel had his eye on!
　Beating you will take me even higher!」

stage0055_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You...!
　Still saying things like that!?」

stage0055_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$, you have no intention of backing
　down, do you!」

stage0055_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Isn't that the same for you?」

stage0055_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I fight... to bring this war to an end...!
　This $c is a gathering of people who
　feel the same!」

stage0055_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's just Federation logic...!
　No matter how you argue it, I can't
　accept it!」

stage0055_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Then I will!
　I'll take away your power to fight!」

stage0055_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Good, that's how it should be!
　We met on the battlefield, so we're
　enemies!」

stage0055_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$! Stop fighting!」

stage0055_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$クェス$$
「Shut up! I fight for the Colonel!」

stage0055_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No good! My words aren't reaching her!」

stage0055_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$クェス$$
「If you're getting in the Colonel's way,
　even if it's $$アムロ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$...! Whatever conviction you hold,
　I won't let you use a child like
　$$クェス$$ this way!）

stage0055_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Are you planning to repeat $$ララァ$$'s
　tragedy!）

stage0055_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$シャア$$
「Stop it, $$カミーユ$$.
　Right now, I am $$シャア・アズナブル$$」

stage0055_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're denying everything
　you fought us for too!?」

stage0055_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$シャア$$
「Without casting off the past, there's no
　moving forward...! Not for me, nor Earth!」

stage0055_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is there a life that's fine to throw away
　for that!? Answer me!」

stage0055_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$シャア$$
「Direct that anger at me, $$カミーユ$$.
　That's all the man I am」

stage0055_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You think words like that will satisfy me!?」

stage0055_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then fight! The answer you're seeking
　lies beyond that!」

stage0055_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You always act like you're carrying
　everything alone!!」

stage0055_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$リディ$$
「He's the true Red Comet...!
　Half-hearted resolve won't beat him!」

stage0055_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$シャア$$
「You seem to have real talent...!
　But unless you widen that narrow view,
　your power's wasted!」

stage0055_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$エマ$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　With the world facing crisis, why are
　you fighting!?」

stage0055_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$シャア$$
「I believe I'm looking beyond that!
　That's why I took this name!」

stage0055_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$エマ$$
「You really have changed from before...
　Maybe that's exactly what Ensign Recoa
　wanted from you...」

stage0055_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$エマ$$
「But I think if she were here,
　she'd have denied who you are now!
　And so would I!」

stage0055_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$シャア$$
「Step aside, Lieutenant $$エマ$$!
　Right now, I am your enemy!」

stage0055_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　So you really did turn against $$アムロ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$カツ$$, is it...!
　Fall back if you don't want to die!」

stage0055_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カツ$$
「Not a chance!
　I'm not the kid shaking on the White Base
　anymore!」

stage0055_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カツ$$
「I'll be the one to end the legend
　of the Red Comet!!」

stage0055_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ファ$$
「Please stop, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　This isn't the time for humanity to
　fight itself!」

stage0055_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$シャア$$
「Fall back, $$ファ$$.
　I don't want to fight you」

stage0055_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$シャア$$
「You're someone $$カミーユ$$ can't do without.
　I don't want to shoot you」

stage0055_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ファ$$
「No! Even if I can't win,
　I'll still fight you!」

stage0055_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ファ$$
「Because I believe it will help $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シャア$$
「With this $$サザビー$$,
　I can more than match your $$νガンダム$$!」

stage0055_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You said it yourself!
　That a mobile suit's performance isn't
　what decides the outcome!」

stage0055_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then are you saying a Newtype's power
　is what decides it?」

stage0055_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's wrong too!
　We... Newtypes aren't a power meant for war!」

stage0055_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand you want to push humanity
　to its next stage!
　But don't use war as the means!」

stage0055_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$シャア$$
「Humanity has reached a point where
　that alone won't hold!」

stage0055_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Then use your words!
　Don't think eggheaded intellectual ideas
　can change people!」

stage0055_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$シャア$$
「Just as I thought!
　It's you who stands in my way, after all!」

stage0055_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If you want to settle this with me,
　I'll oblige! But don't drag all of
　humanity into it!」

stage0055_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　Give $$クェス$$ back!」

stage0055_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$シャア$$
「This straightforwardness of his...
　It's hard to bear」

stage0055_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This is the true Red Comet's pressure...!?」

stage0055_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$シャア$$
（A new power is growing here, too...）

stage0055_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シャア$$
（Can you see it, $$アムロ$$...!
　This is why I rose up!）

stage0055_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The Red Comet!
　Even if I can't win, I'll hold him up!」

stage0055_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not nearly enough to stop me!」

stage0055_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Don't underestimate me!
　I have the pride of a soldier of Echoes...
　of the Earth Federation, too!」

stage0055_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「However many words you pile up, whatever
　ideals you preach, I refuse to accept you,
　who took Geminis' bait and started a war!」

stage0055_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シン$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　I'll keep the promise from the $$多元戦争$$, here!」

stage0055_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$シャア$$
「If I ever strayed from the path,
　you and $$カミーユ$$ would stop me, was that it...」

stage0055_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シン$$
「I won't let $$カミーユ$$ do this!
　I'll be the one to strike you down!」

stage0055_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then you too will face my resolve!」

stage0055_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シン$$
「No matter how many words you pile up,
　you still chose war as your method!
　I will never accept that, not ever!」

stage0055_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$キラ$$
「You have no intention of stopping, Captain $$クワトロ$$?」

stage0055_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$シャア$$
「I don't seek anyone else's understanding.
　...Right now, I'm just like you used to be」

stage0055_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$キラ$$
「If you believe in your own justice,
　then we'll believe in ours...!」

stage0055_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$キラ$$
「Stopping you, stopping this war...!
　That's the answer we've chosen!」

stage0055_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$シャア$$
「Very well, $$キラ$$!
　Then let's wager our own justices
　and fight, you and I!」

stage0055_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Tch...!
　No man's more trouble as an enemy than you!」

stage0055_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シャア$$
「As expected, Major $$オズマ$$!
　Fighting me on even terms!」

stage0055_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Sorry, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I don't plan on settling for even!」

stage0055_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't think you can keep looking down
　on me forever like that!」

stage0055_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$アルト$$
「Get ready, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I'm not soft like $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$シャア$$
「Bothering to say your resolve out loud
　is both your softness, and your charm...!」

stage0055_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No matter how far ahead you read and move,
　you can't escape my aim!」

stage0055_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then I'll simply stay a step ahead, $$ミシェル$$」

stage0055_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Ha... guess I'm broken too.
　My blood's racing, even in a fight like this...!」

stage0055_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ルカ$$
「You're beyond all the data I have on you...!
　Captain $$クワトロ$$ now isn't the one from before!」

stage0055_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$シャア$$
「People grow, that's all.
　And I, who took up this name again,
　have shed everything unnecessary along the way」

stage0055_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ルカ$$
「The same goes for me, $$シャア・アズナブル$$...!
　I'll show you how I've grown!」

stage0055_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Now that you're the enemy, I won't hold back...!
　Don't hold it against me, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0055_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$シャア$$
「Same goes for me.
　Though even if you hate me for it, I won't stop...!」

stage0055_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$クラン$$
「My Zentradi blood, that should race in battle,
　runs cold...! Am I... feeling fear...!?」

stage0055_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then fall back, $$クラン$$!
　I have no wish to fight a pointless battle!」

stage0055_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$クラン$$
「Don't underestimate me, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　Overcoming this fear is what makes me Zentradi!」

stage0055_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「New...? Does that man know about
　the Mythical Aquarion...!?」

stage0055_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Just who is that man...!?
　It's like he's Supreme Commander $$不動$$!」

stage0055_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$桂$$
「This makes twice we've gone at it for real,
　Captain $$クワトロ$$!」

stage0055_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$シャア$$
「You mean back during the $$多元戦争$$...」

stage0055_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$桂$$
「Back then, I swore I'd never fight
　a comrade again as long as I lived,
　and now it's come to this...!」

stage0055_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$シャア$$
「No need to trouble yourself over it.
　Neither of us is being deceived this time,
　we're each fighting under our own convictions」

stage0055_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$桂$$
「For my part, I'd have felt better
　if one of us had just been tricked!」

stage0055_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$桂$$
「But if you're serious, half-measures won't win!
　I'm going all out, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0055_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit bottling it all up inside, man!
　Let more of yourself out!」

stage0055_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「One more thing, I'll tell you!
　War's a load of crap!
　Listen to my soooong!!」

stage0055_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$シャア$$
「You're right about that, $$熱気バサラ$$...」

stage0055_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「A man like you, and you don't understand
　what kind of time this is!?」

stage0055_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$シャア$$
「What I'm looking at lies beyond this war.
　That's why I can't afford to stop here...!」

stage0055_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I misjudged you, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I never wanted to hear a dictator's logic
　come out of your mouth!」

stage0055_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$n
「So this is the true Red Comet's pressure...!」

stage0055_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$シャア$$
「I can't stand watching youth throw their lives away...!」

stage0055_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$n
「I don't plan on dying here!
　You're not my only enemy!」

stage0055_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$シャア$$
「You're not the only one eyeing a distant enemy...!
　I too have reasons I cannot retreat!」

stage0055_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$n
「You talk a lot, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　If you're trying to hide the doubt inside you,
　sorry, but I've no interest in hearing it!」

stage0055_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$n
「However you dress it up, you're my enemy!!」

stage0055_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't let him get in close!
　Layer the barrage two, three deep!」

stage0055_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Not bad, $$ブライト$$...!
　Guess we haven't known each other this long for nothing!」

stage0055_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain!
　The enemy's slipping through every barrage we throw up!」

stage0055_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it!
　So the name Red Comet isn't for nothing!」

stage0055_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$オットー$$
「Anyone with a free hand, man the guns!
　If it comes to this, we'll counter with numbers!」

stage0055_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$シャア$$
（This feeling...
　Is she aboard that ship...）

stage0055_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ラム$$
「All guns, intercept!
　We can't lock onto $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0055_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「To be reminded of his skill in a spot like this...」

stage0055_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But we have no retreat!
　We'll bring this ship's full power to bear
　and take down $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」
